text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco aims at total automation for telephone network in 1997.
- Exceptional rains fill Moroccan reservoirs with record 9.2 billion cubic metres of water.
- Drug trafficking ring operating between Morocco and Paris via Spain dismantled with arrest of five people.
- State must continue to play major role in strategic areas despite privatisation, says MP.
- Union representing drivers of "limousine taxis" call unlimited strike from January 1 in protest at problems, particularly increase in insurance rates.
- Post and Telecommunications plan for 2.334 billion dirham ($265 million) budget for 1997.
- China to work for better economic cooperation and positive trade balance with Morocco.
